# Oordio

> Oordio connects your bookings, cleaners, payments, and schedules into one calm, automated system for short-term rental operators. Stop chasing cleaners. Start running your rentals.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://oordio.com/): Cleaning coordination for Airbnb hosts, fully automated
- [How It Works](https://oordio.com/#how-it-works): Auto-detection, scheduling, smart matching, hands-free monitoring
- [Features](https://oordio.com/#advantages): Oordio Auto-Dispatch, contextual alerts, live job tracking, unified calendar
- [Pricing](https://oordio.com/#pricing): Starter (€19), Pro (€39), Business (€99) — 15-day free trial
- [Get Started](https://app.oordio.com): Sign up for Oordio

## What Oordio Does

- **For hosts**: Auto-assigns primary, backup, and marketplace cleaners; syncs Airbnb/VRBO/iCal; unified calendar; automated payouts; portfolio dashboards
- **For cleaners**: Push notifications for jobs; one-tap accept; photo verification; automatic payouts
- **Pricing**: Starter (3 properties), Pro (10 properties), Business (unlimited)
